name: home-repair
description: People fix things in other people's homes, such as plumbing, electrical work and small repairs, paid per hour or per job.

description.description: The work offered, or what needs fixing.

price.description: The price per hour or for the job.

payment.description: How the job may be paid: direct, job, or both.

place.description: Where the repairer works from and how far they go, or where the home is.

hours.description: When the repairer can come, or when the client is home, each week.

time.description: When the job is wanted: a time, or a span to fit it in.

licences.description: Licences or certificates the repairer holds, such as for gas or electrical work.

photos.description: Photos of what needs fixing, or of past work.

onTime.description: In a review of the repairer: whether they came at the agreed time.

fixed.description: In a review of the repairer: whether the job was done as agreed.

howDealsGo: The client and the repairer agree in messages on what needs fixing, when, and a price per hour or for the job, and pay outside Forest. Each may review the other. Each review names the post.
